options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: ceflogging
options.description: Enable CEF format logs.

options.name: centralizedlearning
options.description: Flag used to enable/disable ADM centralized learning

options.name: clientiploggingheader
options.description: Name of an HTTP header that contains the IP address that the client used to connect to the protected web site or service.

options.name: cookieflags
options.description: Add the specified flags to AppFW cookies. Available setttings function as follows: * None - Do not add flags to AppFW cookies. * HTTP Only - Add the HTTP Only flag to AppFW cookies, which prevent scripts from accessing them. * Secure - Add Secure flag to AppFW cookies. * All - Add both HTTPOnly and Secure flag to AppFW cookies.

options.name: cookiepostencryptprefix
options.description: String that is prepended to all encrypted cookie values.

options.name: defaultprofile
options.description: Profile to use when a connection does not match any policy. Default setting is APPFW_BYPASS, which sends unmatched connections back to the Citrix ADC without attempting to filter them further.

options.name: entitydecoding
options.description: Transform multibyte (double- or half-width) characters to single width characters.

options.name: geolocationlogging
options.description: Enable Geo-Location Logging in CEF format logs.

options.name: importsizelimit
options.description: Maximum cumulative size in bytes of all objects imported to Netscaler. The user is not allowed to import an object if the operation exceeds the currently configured limit.

options.name: learnratelimit
options.description: Maximum number of connections per second that the application firewall learning engine examines to generate new relaxations for learning-enabled security checks. The application firewall drops any connections above this limit from the list of connections used by the learning engine.

options.name: logmalformedreq
options.description: Log requests that are so malformed that application firewall parsing doesn't occur.

options.name: malformedreqaction
options.description: flag to define action on malformed requests that application firewall cannot parse

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: proxypassword
options.description: Password with which proxy user logs on.

options.name: proxyport
options.description: Proxy Server Port to get updated signatures from AWS.

options.name: proxyserver
options.description: Proxy Server IP to get updated signatures from AWS.

options.name: proxyusername
options.description: Proxy Username

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sessioncookiename
options.description: Name of the session cookie that the application firewall uses to track user sessions. Must begin with a letter or number, and can consist of from 1 to 31 letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-) and underscore (_) symbols.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my cookie name" or 'my cookie name').

options.name: sessionlifetime
options.description: Maximum amount of time (in seconds) that the application firewall allows a user session to remain active, regardless of user activity. After this time, the user session is terminated. Before continuing to use the protected web site, the user must establish a new session by opening a designated start URL. A value of 0 represents infinite time.

options.name: sessionlimit
options.description: Maximum number of sessions that the application firewall allows to be active, regardless of user activity. After the max_limit reaches, No more user session will be created .

options.name: sessiontimeout
options.description: Timeout, in seconds, after which a user session is terminated. Before continuing to use the protected web site, the user must establish a new session by opening a designated start URL.

options.name: signatureautoupdate
options.description: Flag used to enable/disable auto update signatures

options.name: signatureurl
options.description: URL to download the mapping file from server

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: undefaction
options.description: Profile to use when an application firewall policy evaluates to undefined (UNDEF). An UNDEF event indicates an internal error condition. The APPFW_BLOCK built-in profile is the default setting. You can specify a different built-in or user-created profile as the UNDEF profile.

options.name: useconfigurablesecretkey
options.description: Use configurable secret key in AppFw operations

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
